name: Securing an Open Society: Canada's National Security Policy (2004)
description: Canada's inaugural 2004 National Security Policy (Privy Council Office), establishing an integrated national security framework across six key strategic areas: intelligence, emergency planning and management, public health emergencies, transport security, border security, and international security.
relationToCloudSecurity: Foundational national security policy establishing the Government Operations Centre and federal cyber/critical-infrastructure protection mandate.
relationToAISecurity: Provides baseline national security intelligence and threat-assessment governance.
